title: Existence of filtered-step cohomology isomorphism
statement: For X,K,T,p,q as in the filtered-step theorem, the filtered step homology is isomorphic to derived cohomology of the stupid truncation.

lean.statement: theorem etale_filtered_step_cohomology_iso (X : Scheme.{u}) (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})) (T : EtaleTermwiseHypercohomology X K) (p q : ℤ) : Nonempty (((T.L.step q : CochainComplex AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ℤ).homology p) ≅ (cohomology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} X p).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (K.obj.stupidTrunc (ComplexShape.embeddingUpIntGE q))))
